content: Gibxe Kawa Amuho
Nam7u laythafe guye, Gibxe Kawoy amuho amuhis. He amuhuwan I Nayle Shaafa gaxan eqis.
Laapun ordenne modho miizati Nayle Shaafape keyidi, maata mishin be7is.
Entafe kaallidi, hara laapun gilqa miizati Nayle Shaafape keyidi, shaafa gaxan de7iya hara miizata matan eqidosona.
He gilqa miizati laapun ordenne modho miizata mittidosona. Hessafe guye, Kawoy barkis.
I zaari dhiskidi, hara amuhoka amuhis. Laapun lo77onne muruuta mor7eti issi maqa bolla keyidosona.
Entafe kaallidi, lee7onne doloha bagga carkon shullida hara laapun mor7eti keyidosona.
He lee7ida mor7eti lo77onne muruuta mor7eta mittidosona. Hessafe guye, Kawoy barkidi amuho gideysa eris.
Sa7ay wontin dhiskofe I dendiya wode iya wozanay yarkis. Hessa gisho, Gibxen de7iya bitanchotanne eranchota ubbaa kawoy xeegisidi entaw ba amuhuwa odis. Shin iyaw he amuhuwa birshiya asi dhayis.
Ushsha kaapoy he wode Gibxe kawako, “Taani ta naaquwa hachi hassayayis.
Issi wode Kawoy ba aylleta hanqetidi, tananne kathaa kaapuwa qasho keethan yeggis.
Yan de7ishe nu nam7ati amuho amuhida. He amuhotas dumma dumma birshethay de7ees.
He wode naageysata kaapuwa aylley, Ibraawe panthay, nuura qashon de7ees. Nuuni nu amuhuwa iyaw odin, I nuus huuphen huuphen amuhuwa billis.
Yaanin, he hanoti I nuus billidaysada hanidosona. Hessi aybe giiko, taani ta shuumatethaako simmas, hankoy kaqetis” yaagis.
Yaatin, Gibxe Kawoy Yoosefa xeegisis. Enti iya qasho keethafe ellesidi ehidosona. I meedetidi ba ma7uwa laammidi, kawako gelis.
Kawoy Yoosefa, “Taani amuho amuhas, shin taw issi asika billanaw danda7ibeenna. Taani, ne amuho billanaw danda7eysa si7as” yaagis.
Yoosefi, “Taani hessa danda7ike, shin Xoossay kawas lo77onne like birshethi immana” yaagis.
Kawoy, “Taani ta amuhora Nayle Shaafa gaxan eqidashin,
laapun ordenne modho miizati Nayle Shaafape keyidi, maata moosona.
Entafe kaallidi, hara laapun gilqanne laafida miizati keyidosona. Taani hessa mela gilqa miizi Gibxe biittan ubbaka be7a erike.
He gilqanne laafida miizati koyro keyida laapun modho miizata mittidosona.
Shin enta mittidaape guye kaseysada gilqi uttida gisho, enti mittidaba oonika eranaw danda7ibeenna. Hessafe guye, taani barkas.
“Taani ta amuhuwan qassi laapun lo77onne muruuta mor7eti issi maqa bolla keydaysata be7as.
Entafe kaallidi, lee7onne doloha bagga carkuwan shullida hara laapun mor7eti keyidosona.
He lee7ida mor7eti laapun lo77o mor7eta midosona. Taani ha amuhuwa bitanchotas odas, shin taw amuhuwa birshiya asi bentibeenna” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Yoosefi Gibxe kawako, “kawa amuhota birshethay issino. Xoossay ba oothana haniyaba kawas qoncisis.
He laapun lo77o miizati laapun laythata, qassi laapun lo77o mor7eti laapun laythata, ha amuhota birshethay issino.
He laapun gilqanne laafida miizati laapun laythata, qassi doloha bagga carkuwan shullida, lee7o laapun mor7eti laapun kosha laythata.
“Taani kawas odidaysadaka, Xoossay ba oothana haniyaba kawa bessis.
Laapun daro kalo laythati Gibxe biitta ubban yaana.
Shin hessafe guye, laapun kosha laythati kaallidi yaana. He wode Gibxe kaaloy ubbay dogetana, koshi biitta caacana.
Koshay daro iita gidiya gisho he biitta kaaloy dogetidi attana.
Nam7u ogiyan kawas he amuhoy bentiday Xoossay ba qopidaba oothanaw qanxida gishosa. Hessa Xoossay mata woden oothana.
“Ha7i hiza, neeni eranchonne cinca asi koyada Gibxe biittan shuuma.
Laapun kalo laythan kaxiya kathaafe ichashu kushiyape issuwa shiishana asata shuuma.
Enti yaa kalo laythan kathaa shiishidi, banta aawatethan kataman kataman minjidi wothana mela kiita.
Biittay koshan dhayona mela ha kathay Gibxe biittan laapun laythan dendana koshas minjetidi de7o” yaagis.
Yoosefi Gibxe Biittan Shuumetetha
Yaatin he oday Gibxe kawasinne iya moorinnatas lo77o gididi bentis.
Hessa gisho, Kawoy entako, “Yoosefape aadhiya hara Xoossa Ayyaanara de7iya asi demmanaw danda7oko” yaagis.
Hessafe guye Kawoy Yoosefa, “Xoossay haysa ubba nena erisida gisho, ne mela eranchoynne cinca asi oonika baawa.
Taani nena ta biittan shuumas. Ta asa ubbay new kiitetana. Taape hari neepe aadhiya oonika baawa.
Heko, taani nena Gibxe biitta ubba bolla shuumas” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Kawoy ba paramiya migiduwa ba biradhiyafe kessidi, Yoosefa biradhen aathis. Boncho ma7onne qoodhe worqa iya mayzis.
Kawoy ba nam7antho para gaariya Yoosefa togisis. Boncho wotaadarey, “Ziggite! Ziggite!” yaagishe iyape sinthara hemetees. Hessada oothidi, kawoy iya Gibxe biitta ubbaa bolla shuumis.
Hessafe guye Kawoy Yoosefa, “Taani kawo gidikoka ne kiittonna oonika Gibxe biitta ubban ba kushiya woyko ba tohuwa qaaxofo” yaagis.
Kawoy Yoosefa, “Xafnaat-Pa7ina” gidi sunthis. I iyaw Ona katama kahiniya Phoxfaara na7iw Asnaato macho immis. Yaanin, Yoosefi Gibxe biitta ubbaa bolla maata ekis.
Yoosefi Gibxe kawas ooso oykiya wode, iyaw laythi hastama. Yoosefi kawa sinthafe keyidi, Gibxe biitta ubbaa giddon hemetis.
He laapun kalo laythan biittan daro kathi kaxis.
Yoosefi Gibxe biittan he laapun kalo laytha katha ubbaa shiishidi, katamatan minjis. Issi issi katama yuushuwan de7iya gadiyape katha ubbaa he katamatan shiishis.
Yoosefi abba shafiya mela daro katha shiishis. Katha darotethaafe dendoysan makanaw danda7etibona gisho, maki maki qoleysa aggaagis.
Kosha laythi yaanape sinthe, Ona katama kahine Phoxfaara na7e Asnaatipe Yoosefi nam7u adde nayta yelis.
Yoosefi ba bayra na7aa sunthaa, “Xoossay tana ta metuwanne ta aawa soo asa ubbaa dogisis” gidi Minaase
gidi sunthis.
Nam7antho na7aa sunthaaka, “Xoossay ta metootida biittan taw na7a immis” gidi Efreema
gidi sunthis.
Gibxe biittan de7iya he laapun kalo laythati aadhidosona.
Yoosefi odidaysada laapun kosha laythati kaalli yidosona. Hara biitta ubban koshi keyis, shin Gibxe biitta ubban kathay de7ees.
Gibxe biittay ubbay koshatida wode, asay kathas kawako waassidosona. Kawoy Gibxe asa ubba, “Yoosefako bidi, I odeysa oothite” yaagidi kiittis.
Koshay Gibxe biitta ubba gakida wode, Yoosefi katha minjida shaaleta ubba dooydi, kathi Gibxe asaas bayzis.
Biitta ubban koshi suullida gisho, sa7an de7iya asa ubbay kathi Yoosefape shammanaw Gibxe yidosona.
